comparisons.what: Compare CAR and MOR at equal dose and at equal roughness, and say where each is better and why (absorption, amplification, blur).

constraints: A long run is allowed; report the runtime.
Report every number with its uncertainty (Monte Carlo error, fit error) and say when a result is only a check of the code.
Say plainly which resist parameters are assumed rather than measured, and how the conclusions depend on them.
State every other parameter you assume with a source or a reason.

Imaging: NA 0.55, a thin binary mask, scalar imaging with a dipole source for the lines and a quasar or annular source for the contacts (state the choice); the aerial image only sets the mean exposure, the stochastics come from the resist.
Python with numpy and scipy, matplotlib with the Agg backend; Monte Carlo with fixed, stated seeds and enough trials for the reported uncertainty.
Cite only sources you have actually found and read; if a reference cannot be confirmed, say so rather than citing it.
